baseline_299248_original_numerics.zone_quality_note: Tank and headspace metrics are native cellZone reductions on each mesh; mixed cells are 0.01 < alpha.water < 0.99.

tank_refined_456954_original_numerics.zone_quality_note: Tank and headspace metrics are native cellZone reductions on each mesh; mixed cells are 0.01 < alpha.water < 0.99.

eos_R_correction_vs_v1.expected_effect: Gas EOS density and gas mass only shift uniformly by this factor; p, V, water, gas-mass-weighted T, and mixed gas mass shares are invariant to this common factor up to floating-point roundoff. Verified field-reduction checks follow.

baseline_299248_original_numerics.numerics: Original d3daff binary; 8 outer / 2 pressure correctors, transonic; the 6.25 mm axial-source reference. Binary hash listed under per-case files.

tank_refined_456954_original_numerics.numerics: Tank-interface-refined case; same declared solver dictionaries and physics; lean 23743d source/audit build with expensive audit diagnostics disabled. No solver launch by this analysis.

normalization_and_methods.bounds: Single startup snapshot; no convergence order or causal attribution. Tank payload inventories match, but headspace capacity differs by remeshing and total initial water differs by about 7.1 mL in the two line feeds. The compiled binaries differ in audit instrumentation, while fvSolution, fvSchemes, fvOptions, and thermophysical dictionaries are byte-identical. The refined controlDict also disables the expensive full pressure audit and writes full native fields less often; neither changes the equations.
normalization_and_methods.gas_mass_and_temperature: Ideal-air EOS rho_g=p/(R_air*T.air), with R_air=287.0477481284761 J/kg/K from the exact v2512 universal gas constant divided by thermophysicalProperties.air molWeight=28.96546000 kg/kmol; integrate (1-alpha)*rho_g*V; report mass-weighted native T.air. This is a phase EOS reduction, not a solver ledger.
normalization_and_methods.gas_pressure: Gas-volume-weighted native absolute p over all tank-zone cells, weighted by (1-alpha.water)*cellVolume; p0 is that case/tank’s own t=0 value. Also report gas-volume-weighted p restricted to tankHeadspaceZone.
normalization_and_methods.gas_volume: Within each tankAZone/tankBZone, sum((1-alpha.water)*native cellVolume). Each mesh uses its own native t=0 value as Vg0.
normalization_and_methods.mixed_cells: 0.01 < alpha.water < 0.99; mixed-cell gas volume and EOS gas mass divided by total tank-zone gas volume/mass.
normalization_and_methods.seat_flux: Exact saved surfaceFieldValue sum(alphaPhi0.water) on native oriented valveSeat faceZones, one value per each of two valves; normals point +x, sign as stored. No sampled-plane flux substituted.
normalization_and_methods.tank_water: Sum(alpha.water*V) within each tankZone; mass uses rhoConst water=998.2 kg/m3. Also report per-train lineZone and whole-domain initial water to avoid implying equal total system inventories.
normalization_and_methods.thermodynamic_curves: Isothermal/adiabatic pressure ratios are reference limits evaluated at observed Vg/Vg0; not fitted closures or validation.

objective: Exact common native time comparison of own-initial-normalized gas pressure/volume, gas-mass-weighted T, mixed-cell gas share, tank water, and oriented native seat water flux.

physical_time.comparison_method: Only exact native snapshots at the same physical time; no interpolation or extrapolation. Both processor uniform/time values are equal to the required time within 1e-11 s.
